title: EMA target encoder essential for training
description: The exponential moving average update for the target encoder is stated as essential for training joint-embedding architectures with Vision Transformers. The method relies on this mechanism without exploring alternatives.
canonical_description: exponential moving average target encoder essential for training joint-embedding architectures

evidence.quote: The use of an exponential moving average target-encoder has proven essential for training JEAs with Vision Transformers, we find the same to be true for I-JEPA.
